```{r}
    girg = startsWith(graph, "girg"),
    girg_scale = startsWith(graph, "scale"),
    real = !girg & !girg_scale,
    #extvalsel = graph %in% selectedreal$graph, #"selected" in external validity paper

    #sparse = avgdeg < 100,

  )
stats

from_wrong_website <- setdiff(stats %>% filter(real) %>% pull(graph), realnames$graph)
stats <- stats %>%
  filter(!graph %in% from_wrong_website, # only keep real networks from 3006 dataset
         !graph %in% duplicates$graph) # remove duplicates from 3006

diam <- tibble(read.csv("../output/teex_diameter.csv")) %>%
  filter(!graph %in% from_wrong_website) %>%
  select(graph, diameter)
stats <- stats %>% left_join(diam)

girg_stats <- stats %>%
  filter(girg | girg_scale) %>%
  extract(
    col = graph,
    into = c("n_gen", "ple", "temp", "deg", "sample"),
    regex = "scale(\\d+)_([\\d\\.]+)_(\\d+(?:\\.\\d+)?)_(\\d+)_(\\d+)\\.edges",
    remove = FALSE,
    convert = TRUE
  )

#expan_raw <- tibble(read.csv("../output/expan_merged.csv"))
print("Creating expan table.")
expan_raw <- tibble(read.csv("../output/expan_merged.csv")) %>%
  filter(!graph %in% from_wrong_website) %>%
  filter(!graph %in% duplicates$graph) %>%
  filter(alpha != 0.05) %>%
  left_join(stats%>%select(graph, m), by = "graph") %>%
  mutate(
    # relative overlap theorem
    overlap_relative = overlap / dist,
    relevant_overlap_rel = if_else(rel_dist <= 0, 1, overlap / rel_dist),
    relevant_overlap_rel = pmin(1, pmax(-1, relevant_overlap_rel)),
    wc_exponent = pmax(0,
                       pmin(1,
                            1 -
                            (relevant_overlap_rel*(1-alpha) / (log(bplus) / log(b) + relevant_overlap_rel))
                            )
                       ),
    thm4c = relevant_overlap_rel / (log(m)/log(2)),
    thm4_wcexp = pmax(0, pmin(1, 1-thm4c/2)),
    cost_uni = (cost_uni_s+cost_uni_t)/2,
    bi_exp_m = log(cost_bi) / log(m),
    bi_exp_uni = log(cost_bi) / log(cost_uni),
    uni_exp_m = log(cost_uni) / log(m),
    high2 = pmax(S2, T2),
    low1 = pmin(S1, T1),
    rho = if_else(low1 == 0 & high2 == 0, 0,  high2 / low1),
    rho = if_else(rho < 0, 0, rho),
    rho_thresh = (1-alpha) / (1-alpha+(alpha * log(bplus) / log(b))),
    delta_rho = log(rho_thresh) - log(rho),
  )

expan <- expan_raw %>% 
  group_by(b, alpha, graph) %>%
   summarise(
     num_div0by0 = sum(low1==0 & high2 == 0),
     across(c(rho, rho_thresh,delta_rho), median, .names = "median_{.col}"),
     across(-c(median_rho, median_rho_thresh, median_delta_rho, num_div0by0), mean),
     .groups = "drop"
   ) %>%
  left_join(stats %>% select(!m), by = "graph")


gc()
```

# Infrastructure for latex
```{r}
roundnum <- function(num, digits) {
  format(round(num, digits), nsmall = digits)
}

store_result <- function(list_name, identifier, value, digits = 2) {
  # Get the name of the list as a string
  list_name_str <- deparse(substitute(list_name))
  
  # Format the value
  formatted_value <- roundnum(value, digits)
  
  # Get the list from the parent frame and modify it
  list_obj <- get(list_name_str, envir = parent.frame())
  list_obj[[identifier]] <- formatted_value
  
  # Assign the modified list back to the parent environment
  assign(list_name_str, list_obj, envir = parent.frame())
}

# Function to write results to a LaTeX file
write_latex_vars <- function(list_name, filename = "output.tex/eval_statistics.tex") {
  # Get the list
  list_obj <- get(deparse(substitute(list_name)), envir = parent.frame())
  
  # Create directory if it doesn't exist
  dir_path <- dirname(filename)
  if (dir_path != "." && !dir.exists(dir_path)) {
    dir.create(dir_path, recursive = TRUE)
  }
  
  latex_lines <- sapply(names(list_obj), function(id) {
    paste0("\\newcommand{\\", id, "}{", list_obj[[id]], "}")
  })
  
  writeLines(latex_lines, filename)
}
  
results_list <- list()
store_result(results_list, "numRealNetworks", length(stats %>% filter(real) %>% pull(graph) %>% unique), 0)
store_result(results_list, "numGIRGS", length(stats %>% filter(girg_scale) %>% pull(graph) %>% unique), 0)
write_latex_vars(results_list)
```

# Statistics of classifiers
```{r}
# Function to compute metrics
compute_metrics <- function(x, y) {
  tp <- sum(y == 1 & x == 1)
  fp <- sum(y == 0 & x == 1)
  fn <- sum(y == 1 & x == 0)
  tn <- sum(y == 0 & x == 0)

  precision <- ifelse(tp + fp > 0, tp / (tp + fp), 0)
  recall <- ifelse(tp + fn > 0, tp / (tp + fn), 0)
  accuracy <- (tp + tn) / (tp + fp + fn + tn)
  f1 <- ifelse(precision + recall > 0, 2 * (precision * recall) / (precision + recall), 0)

  tibble(f1, precision, recall, accuracy)
}

compute_metrics_cutoff <- function(cutoff, df, target_col, binary_pred, target_fun) {
  binary_target <- target_fun(df[[target_col]], cutoff) # Apply custom target function
  compute_metrics(binary_pred, binary_target) %>%
    mutate(cutoff = cutoff)
}


find_optimal_cutoff <- function(df, predictor_col, target_col, cutoffs = seq(0, 1, by = 0.001),
                                prediction_fun = function(x) x > 0,
                                target_fun = function(y, thresh) y < thresh) {
  # Precompute predictor-based binary classification using custom function
  binary_pred <- as.integer(prediction_fun(df[[predictor_col]]))

  # Compute all cutoffs efficiently
  results <- map_dfr(cutoffs, ~compute_metrics_cutoff(.x, df, target_col, binary_pred, target_fun))
  
  best <- results %>%
    slice_max(f1, with_ties = TRUE) %>%
    slice_max(accuracy, with_ties = TRUE) %>%
    slice_min(cutoff, with_ties = FALSE)
  best_cutoff <- best %>% pull(cutoff)
  best_f1 <- best %>% pull(f1)
  best_acc <- best %>% pull(accuracy)
  
  return(list(cutoff = best_cutoff, f1 = best_f1, acc = best_acc, results = results))
}
```

# Exponent Analysis
```{r}
exponent_analysis <- function(data, xcol, ycol, xname, yname) {
  # Calculate correlations
  correlation <- cor(data[[xcol]], data[[ycol]], method = "pearson")
  spearman <- cor(data[[xcol]], data[[ycol]], method = "spearman")

  cat("Pearson Correlation:", correlation, "\n")
  cat("Spearman Correlation:", spearman, "\n")

  # Fit linear model
  lm_fit <- lm(reformulate(xcol, ycol), data = data)

  # Calculate absolute deviations
  data <- data %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(deviation = abs(.data[[ycol]] - predict(lm_fit)))

  # Calculate percentages within deviation thresholds
  within_0.05 <- mean(data$deviation <= 0.05) * 100
  within_0.10 <- mean(data$deviation <= 0.10) * 100
  within_0.15 <- mean(data$deviation <= 0.15) * 100

  cat(sprintf("%.2f%% of networks are within 0.05 of the linear model.\n", within_0.05))
  cat(sprintf("%.2f%% of networks are within 0.10 of the linear model.\n", within_0.10))
  cat(sprintf("%.2f%% of networks are within 0.15 of the linear model.\n", within_0.15))

  # Extract coefficients
  intercept <- coef(lm_fit)[1]
  slope <- coef(lm_fit)[2]

  # Create plot
  plot <- ggplot(data, aes(x = .data[[xcol]], y = .data[[ycol]])) +
    geom_hex(bins = 15, color = "lightgray") +
    scale_fill_gradient2(
#      trans = "log", breaks = c(1, 4, 16, 64, 256)
    ) +
    geom_abline(intercept = intercept, slope = slope, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_abline(intercept = intercept + 0.1, slope = slope, color = "black", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_abline(intercept = intercept - 0.1, slope = slope, color = "black", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.3) +
#    geom_abline(intercept = intercept + 0.15, slope = slope, color = "black", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.3) +
#    geom_abline(intercept = intercept - 0.15, slope = slope, color = "black", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.3) +
#    geom_abline(intercept = intercept + 0.05, slope = slope, color = "black", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.3) +
#    geom_abline(intercept = intercept - 0.05, slope = slope, color = "black", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.3) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "top",
      legend.spacing = unit(0, "cm"),
      legend.margin = margin(0,0,0,0, "cm"),
      legend.box.margin = margin(0,0,0,0, "cm"),
      legend.box.spacing = unit(0.05, "cm"),
      legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "cm"),
      legend.key.height = unit(0.2, "cm")
    ) +
    labs(x = xname,
         y = yname,
         fill = "Nr. of networks")

  return(list(corr=correlation, spearman=spearman, lm=lm_fit, closefrac=within_0.10, plot=plot))
}
``` 

```{r}
# Function to format `b` into a LaTeX-safe string
format_b_latex <- function(prefix, b) {
  # Convert number to character and split into individual characters
  b_chars <- str_split(as.character(b), "")[[1]]
  
  # Convert digits to words, keep "." as "Dot"
  word_parts <- map_chr(b_chars, function(char) {
    if (char == ".") {
      return("Dot")  # Keep dot as "Dot"
    } else {
      return(str_to_title(english(as.numeric(char))))  # Convert digits to words with capitalization
    }
  })
  
  # Combine the prefix and transformed number
  str_c(prefix, paste(word_parts, collapse = ""))
}
```

```{r}
# try to search across est. exp thresholds

thresholds <- seq(0.4, 0.75, 0.001)
results_diam <- map_dfr(thresholds, function(thresh) {
  df <- expan %>%
    filter(real) %>%
    mutate(
      diam_exp = log(diameter) / log(n),
      estexp_sublin = bi_exp_m < thresh
    )
  # Skip thresholds that produce only one class
  if(length(unique(df$estexp_sublin)) < 2) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  cutpointr(df, diam_exp, estexp_sublin,
            pos_class = TRUE,
            method = maximize_metric,
            metric = F1_score,
            direction = "<=") %>%
    mutate(threshold = thresh)
})

results_diam %>% ggplot(aes(x=threshold,y=F1_score)) + geom_line() + labs(x="Threshold for estimated exponent", y = "F1-score")

diam_maxf1 <- results_diam %>% slice_max(F1_score, with_ties = FALSE)

store_result(results_list, "diameterAccuracy", diam_maxf1$acc, 3)
store_result(results_list, "diameterCut", diam_maxf1$optimal_cutpoint, 3)
store_result(results_list, "diameterEstExpCut", diam_maxf1$threshold, 3)
write_latex_vars(results_list)
```

## Scores plot
```{r}


# Plot F1-score vs cutoff
scores_plot <- function(data) {
  ggplot(data, aes(x = cutoff)) +
    geom_line(aes(y = f1, color="F1")) +
    geom_line(aes(y = recall, color="Recall")) +
    geom_line(aes(y = precision, color="Precision")) +
    geom_line(aes(y = accuracy, color="Accuracy")) +
    labs(title = "F1-score for different cutoffs", x = "Cutoff for bi_exp_m", y = "F1-score")
}

expan_scores <- find_optimal_cutoff(expan, predictor_col = "relevant_overlap_rel", target_col = "bi_exp_m")
#optimal <- find_optimal_cutoff(expan %>% mutate(bi_exp_m = log(cost_bi)/log(m)), predictor_col = "relevant_overlap_rel", target_col = "bi_exp_m")

grouped_exp_scores <- expan %>%
  filter(interesting) %>%
  group_by(alpha, b) %>%
  nest() %>%
  mutate(
    optimal_cutoff = map(data, ~find_optimal_cutoff(.x, predictor_col = "relevant_overlap_rel", target_col = "bi_exp_m"))
  ) %>%
  unnest_wider(c(optimal_cutoff)) %>%
  unnest(results)  # Unnest the detailed metrics for each cutoff if needed

expan_scores$results %>% scores_plot()
```
